title: Make FileKeyStore identity state rollback-resistant
description: python/src/lichen/crypto/key_persistence.py FileKeyStore accepts rollback and ambiguous identity state. After a successful store, deleting both node_seed slots makes load_seed return None even with fail_closed=True, so callers can bootstrap a different node identity. Corrupting/deleting only the newest slot silently restores the older seed, and two valid equal-generation slots with different seeds silently select slot 0. The unanchored u32 generation/checksum cannot distinguish first boot, interrupted write, deletion, stale restore, or divergent slots. Add durable initialization plus an independent monotonic/authenticated rollback anchor (or an equivalent provisioned floor), reject complete deletion and stale restoration after initialization, reject equal-generation divergence, validate fail_closed as an exact bool, and add adversarial deletion/latest-slot/equal-generation/restart tests.
